serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
So the blog got suspended, huh…
I kinda feel guilty that it is my and Richard’s fault, but what other choice did we have?
I’m very grateful to Richard for his help with DAK. He took the risk even though he was told not to.
Let’s ask him how he’s feeling after reading the recent blog post…
AbusedTenant: Hi Richard, did you read the blog post?
Little_Richard: Yeah, I read it
AbusedTenant: How are you holding up?
Little_Richard: I’m fine. Kinda scared that I somehow fucked up the whole setup for DAK and that the police will come through my door when I least suspect, but besides that I’m doing fine.
AbusedTenant: I meant to ask how are you feeling after reading the blog…
Little_Richard: Oh, right
Little_Richard: To be honest I don’t care that much. Admin kinda left us hanging and we did what we had to do.
Little_Richard: In dms I got a feeling that he’s angry with us, or maybe just disappointed, but I hardly care.
AbusedTenant: He wrote that he doesn’t blame us though? 
Little_Richard: He wrote a very neutral post, like always. I have a feeling that he would be much more happy if I just shot DAK in the back of his head.
AbusedTenant: Why would you think that?
Little_Richard: It would solve all his problems, wouldn’t it? You need to understand that this blog is his life project. He’s been doing this covert work for years. He learned to code just for this. It’s obvious he feels at least disappointed, I would be too.
AbusedTenant: It makes sense.
Little_Richard: Anyway, chat will soon shut down too.
Little_Richard: Catch ya later!
AbusedTenant: Yeah!
It seems that for now this is over.
I will have a chance to catch a breather. I’m kinda mentally tired after having a crazed gunman on my tail…
